original_QABC_crosscheck.original_text: Capacitatea de serviciu Cs a unei linii electrice aeriene simetrice, având capacităţile C12=C23=C31 =C şi neglijînd influenţa pământului, este:

original_A_B_C.B: Cs=C/3
original_A_B_C.C: Cs=C

original_QABC_crosscheck.external_AI_option_text: Cs=C

correction_rationale.result: External AI C not accepted. In symmetric balanced three-phase model, q1=C(V1-V2)+C(V1-V3)=3CV1 (V1+V2+V3=0). Service per-phase Cs=3C. Source https://consultform.ro/anre/wp-content/uploads/2021/09/Retele-electrice-note-de-curs.pdf; textbook https://ro.scribd.com/document/560257221/Carte-Retele-Electrice-2020 clearly states Cs=3*Cff+Cp. External AI used mismatched (C12+C23+C31)/3; also fails charge per-phase definition. Grade II imported C still requires true authentic answer-key reconciliation.
